caption: The drawing features a pair of light blue trousers as the main object, rendered with subtle shading to suggest form and dimension. The trousers are depicted from the front, with details such as a button fly, wide waistband, side pockets, belt loops, and additional buttoned tabs at the ankles. The stitching and seams are outlined in slightly darker blue, and the shading on the fabric ranges from pale blue to a more saturated tone. To the upper right of the main image, there is a smaller, line-drawn sketch of the same trousers from the back view, showing the position of the seams, waistband adjustments using ties at the back, and the same buttoned ankle tabs. The background is plain and beige, with no additional objects present.
title: Knee Pants
